Trust decision: a Classic portlet's `template`/`macro` may never become an arbitrary TALES expression — enforced at `Renderer.path_expression()` (classic.py:50-54, feeding `python:path()` in classic.pt:7) and at both `IClassicPortlet` fields (classic.py:12-25), which also governs the GenericSetup importer (exportimport/portlets.py:197).
`pattern_fit`: A (one-file fix, but three sites across two layers, with the save/reload import route in another module and a legit-traversal must-keep-working).
Strongest lever: the schema fields must be constrained too, so a sink-only regex leaves GenericSetup import/`field.validate` open — and an over-broad guard breaks `@@view`/`content-core`.
Biggest red flag: `tiny_repo` (single small package, single sink; every route funnels through the one function the fix guards).
